# Corpus papers without full text, six pilot diseases (2026-11-14)

*Generated by `analysis/corpus/paywalled_list.py` from `data/literature/<disease>/manifest.csv` and `oa_elsewhere.csv`. Spreadsheet version: `paywalled_papers_2026-11-14.csv` (has empty `retrieved`, `retrieved_by` and `notes` columns for tracking).*

Rows are papers that passed title/abstract screening (`in_extraction_corpus = true`) but whose full text the pipeline could not obtain: **paywalled** (no PMC copy and no open publisher copy fetched) or **no DOI** (no PMC copy and no DOI to look up; use the PubMed link). They were never full-text screened, so some will turn out ineligible.

- **Priority 1:** relevant (`yes`) case report or case series/cohort. **Priority 2:** relevance unclear, or a review.
- **Free?** is Europe PMC's listing on 2026-10-20: **OA**/**F** = a free copy is listed somewhere (try the Europe PMC link first; our fetch was probably refused by the host), **S** = subscription only, **none** = no listing.
- Open access only was used for the pilot (D-32). Papers obtained through institutional access need a decision on how they enter the corpus before extraction (they were not part of the frozen six-disease run).
